card.name: "the" before historical eras and wars
card.fires_on: The word "the" in history texts, right before the name of a war, revolution, dynasty era or period (e.g. the Japanese invasion, the founding, the twentieth century). Often follows words like during, prior to, before, of or a comma in a list of events.

modes.label: After time linkers
modes.description: "the" after during, prior to, before or on the eve of, leading into an historical event or period.
modes.example: General Vladimir Kappel, a leader in the White Army during<< the>> Russian Civil War was reburied in

modes.label: In lists of events
modes.description: "the" in a list of historical events or after "and", before a named war or invasion.
modes.example: work Big Breasts and Wide Hips, the story of a mother and her seven daughters set against the backdrop of the fall of the Qing Dynasty,<< the>> Japanese invasion and the Cultural Revolution, was

card.writes: It leans toward the next word being a proper name or period term such as Bone or Me, and away from Great or Central, so it steers away from "the Great War" type continuations.
card.plain: It marks the word "the" in history writing just before a named war, revolution or era.
